name: Claude API
purpose: The Claude API enables developers to integrate advanced language understanding, reasoning, code generation, vision, and tool use into their applications. It solves problems by allowing applications to engage in complex multi-step reasoning, generate human-like text, analyze images, and interact with external tools, built with Anthropic's Constitutional AI for safety and reliability.
keyCapabilities: Advanced natural language understanding and generation
Multi-modal input (text and images) with text output
Tool use (function calling) for external interactions
Constitutional AI for safety and ethical alignment
integrations: Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, C#, Ruby, PHP SDKs
useCases: Building intelligent chatbots and conversational AI assistants

researchPapers.title: Context Engineering for Multi-Agent LLM Code Assistants Using Elicit, NotebookLM, ChatGPT, and Claude Code

From LLM to NMT: Advancing Low-Resource Machine Translation with Claude
